Who We Are

A Pragmatic Approach to
Sustainable Investment

An independent firm built on analysis, integrity, and long-term vision — operating at the intersection of financial performance and positive impact.

Maverick Global Investments is an independent firm dedicated to creating long-term value through disciplined capital allocation and active asset management. In partnership with Adoria Partners and selected qualified operators, we build portfolios of real assets that combine financial returns, structural solidity, and measurable environmental impact.

We bridge the gap between financial performance and environmental responsibility, targeting stable, measurable returns through a rigorous due diligence process. Our team integrates financial, strategic, and industrial expertise to identify value opportunities across European energy and sustainable infrastructure markets. Every investment decision is grounded in quantitative analysis, clear methodology, and a long-term horizon.

Operating from Milan, we maintain deep connections with Italian and European markets while leveraging international best practices. Our independence allows us to make decisions based purely on merit, risk assessment, and alignment with our sustainability principles.

Our Principles

Three Pillars of
Our Approach

Independence

Investment choices based on analysis, not fashion. We maintain complete autonomy in decision-making, free from conflicts of interest or market pressures.

Sustainability

Every asset must generate both economic and environmental value simultaneously. We don't see these as trade-offs — they are complementary objectives.

Transparency

Clear processes, direct communication, responsible management at every level. Our partners always know where their capital is and how it is performing.

Rooted in Milan

Milan: Our Hub for European Opportunity

From Milan, we access the full breadth of Italian and European capital markets. The city's position as a financial and industrial centre gives us proximity to deal flow, regulatory expertise, and the institutional relationships that underpin every successful investment.

We combine local market depth with a pan-European investment horizon, enabling us to source proprietary opportunities and execute with the speed and certainty that quality assets demand.
